messages:
maria (Support): Heads up - acme-prod tenant can't export audit logs after last night's HSM rotation. Customer sees KMS error 'key_locked' and SCIM provisioning 500s. Escalating.
ben (CSE): Customer pasted errors: `\{"error\":\"key_locked\",\"code\":409\}` and SCIM returning `500 internal server error` when hitting /scim/v2/Users
hsm-bot: HSM rotation job failed on cluster us-east-1 at 2026-03-16T03:12Z - rollback not applied
tom (SRE): assigning. Can you paste the tenant_id and original request id? Also any repro curl?
maria (Support): tenant_id: tenant_acme_42; request_id: 0a1b2c3d. Customer sent repro: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/tenant/tenant_acme_42/audit/export` -> 502 gateway then `\{"error\":\"key_locked\"\}`
julian (Eng-Infra): Looks like DEK couldn't be unwrapped because HSM refused due to pending rotation. Checking HSM control plane logs now.
sasha (Security): Is there any chance keys were rotated with new policy that removed the service principal? Need to confirm rotation plan.
tom (SRE): Quick mitigation: can we fallback to the staging KMS or a previously wrapped key? If not, we should pause export jobs and notify billing for possible retry charges.
julian (Eng-Infra): We have a snapshot of DEKs in backup-store. I can attempt safe unwrap with admin-only HSM key if approved by security. ETA 45m.
sasha (Security): Approve manual unwrap under incident policy. Record steps and get 2FA. Proceed, julian.
maria (Support): Communicating to customer: "We're initiating a manual key unwrap, ETA ~45m. Exports paused to avoid duplicate billing. We'll follow up with audit trail." :white_check_mark:
ben (CSE): Customer asked whether SSO/SCIM provisioning failures are related. They see `POST /scim/v2/Users -> 500` after export attempts timed out.
tom (SRE): SCIM 500s might be cascade from export job locking account-level metadata. Check scim-service logs for `502` in the same timeframe.
julian (Eng-Infra): Found error: `panic: missing-key for tenant_acme_42` in scim-service logs at 03:15Z. Repro command attached:
```
http POST https://internal.scim.svc/Users Authorization:"Bearer $INTERNAL"
{
  \"schemas\": [\"urn:ietf:params:scim:2.0:User\"],
  \"userName\": \"j.doe@acme.com\"
}
```
sasha (Security): After manual unwrap we'll rotate back to a safe key and add a temporary allowlist for the service principal. Also we need to produce an auditable runbook for this incident for compliance.
maria (Support): Note for audit export: we need to re-run export after unwrap; keep a copy of original export_attempt_id=0a1b2c3d for traceability.
ben (CSE): Customer confirmed acceptance of workaround. They're asking for root cause timeline and when access will be restored.
tom (SRE): Action items: julian manual unwrap (owner) | sasha confirm policy changes & doc (owner) | maria send customer updates every 30 mins. I'll open INC-2026-0316 and attach logs. ETA target restore: 60m.
julian (Eng-Infra): Starting unwrap now. I'll post status updates here. First log: `unwrap_attempt 1 -> HSM response TIMEOUT`, retrying.
hsm-bot: HSM manual unwrap completed for tenant_acme_42 at 2026-03-16T04:02Z - operation_id hsm-op-789
julian (Eng-Infra): Verified audit export can now access DEK. Running export dry-run, no duplicates. SCIM provisioning also responding 201 for new user.
maria (Support): Customer notified - exports resumed, SCIM repro confirmed. They'll validate on their side. Closing escalation after 24h monitoring. :lock_with_key:
sasha (Security): We'll prepare retention/audit addendum and include HSM operation_id in the compliance packet.
tom (SRE): Closing incident in 24h unless regression. INC-2026-0316 linked to ticket 12345 for billing adjustment if any double-charges.
